facts.claim: Patcher application tries two configured update sources, and backend selectors 0/1/2 correspond to CurlHttp, SocketHttp and WininetHttp. Each operation has up to three attempts. This does not define a game business protocol.

Trim whole text using bytes space/TAB/CR/LF; split by closing brace. For each block sequentially remove every CR, TAB, space and exact opening-brace-plus-LF substring; trim again. Split helper retains interior empties and drops only an empty final tail.

Factory splits on LF, requires at least two lines, exact lowercase create/append/replaceto matches select distinct vtables. Later LF lines split by colon and exactly two pieces enter a case-sensitive byte-key map; insertion discards later duplicates.
Target is current-directory + path + name with slash normalization. URL is http://host:port/cg50/path/name.bz2?time=<time>. URL suffix alone does not establish compression.

Download uses target.download then invokes object vtable+4. Archive backend searches ZIP EOCD bytes PK0506, reads classic ZIP records and enumerates/extracts all entries. Create/replaceto extract to target parent; append to its unzip subdirectory. No evidence establishes bzip2 payloads.

Create/replaceto require name and md5 and skip download when target MD5 bytes equal manifest text. GetFileAttributesExA supplies the low32 length used over a mapped file; full digest scope is bounded to supported sizes. Files above4GiB are not validated. Post-download MD5 is logged; the observed branch does not enforce another equality check before success.

Append requires name and old_name, skips a missing base, downloads/extracts, reads the named staged chunk, seeks the old file to end, writes the chunk, and moves old_name to name. Extra staging entries are not copied into final files.
When an update is needed and old_name is nonempty, replaceto constructs a shell deletion command before download. Independent implementation never constructs or executes that command.

inferences.claim: A native failure after pre-download deletion may leave no recovery; full failure/retry/rollback behavior has not been dynamically validated.

unverified: Actual Update.TXT/server archives were not fetched; all executable analysis is static.
Native Win32 ANSI/DBCS, filesystem errors, permissions, shell behavior, retry outcomes and original application execution remain unverified.
Strict memory candidate transaction, ASCII paths, budgets and final MD5 enforcement are implementation policies; not claims of native equivalence.
output_policy: No binaries, extracted official resources, long decompilation or actual session data copied into delivery.
